## Translation contribution

**Locale:** `<code>`

**Scope:** Studio / generated website / documentation components

**Change:** New locale / update / terminology fix

**Native speaker or reviewer:** 

**Notes:** Mention untranslated sections, terminology decisions, or UI layouts that might need screenshots.

### Checklist

- [ ] I translated message **values**, not keys.
- [ ] I kept all `{namedPlaceholders}` unchanged.
- [ ] I did not add HTML, scripts, or raw Markdown.
- [ ] I ran `node scripts/validate.mjs` and `node --test`, or reviewed CI.
- [ ] I agree this translation can be distributed under MIT.
